description: Run a whole paper exchange of scripted traders in one call and report it: for comparing set-ups, such as how much leverage turns a shock into a cascade. A simulation, not a forecast.

leverage.description: How many times its equity an agent may hold in positions when it opens them. Default 2.

maintenance_margin.description: An agent whose equity falls below this share of its gross positions is sold out by force. Default 0.25.

personas.description: How many scripted traders of each kind. Default 8 market makers, 8 value, 6 momentum, 8 noise, 4 deleveragers, 4 stop-loss, 4 levered longs.

seed.description: The same seed and the same orders give the same market. Default 1.

shocks.description: Things that happen at set steps. Agents see them only through prices.

kind.description: value: the asset's true worth jumps. liquidity: market makers pull their quotes for some steps. block_sale: one large holder sells at market.

percent.description: For value: how far it jumps.

starting_cash.description: Made-up money each agent starts with. Default 100000.

name: exchange_run
title: Run a whole paper exchange
